# Known vulnerabilities the dependency audit accepts, one advisory ID per line,
# each with the reason it does not apply. Re-check when the pin that keeps the
# package back is lifted, and remove the line then.
#
# transformers is pinned below 5 (pyproject.toml: 5.x needs separate
# sentence-transformers / llama-index compatibility checks). Every advisory below
# needs an attacker-controlled model repository or checkpoint, or the Trainer /
# checkpoint-conversion / custom-generate code paths Folio does not use. Folio
# loads the models its configuration names. Caveat: `rag.embedding.model` and
# `rag.rerank.model` can be changed at runtime by a rag:admin token, so this
# acceptance assumes rag:admin holders are trusted with the server.
PYSEC-2025-217     # X-CLIP checkpoint conversion: unpickling an untrusted checkpoint
PYSEC-2026-2288    # Trainer._load_rng_state torch.load: training only
PYSEC-2026-2289    # malicious config.json in a model repository
PYSEC-2026-2290    # LightGlue loading from an attacker-controlled repository
PYSEC-2026-3929    # path traversal in save_pretrained(): Folio does not save tokenizers
PYSEC-2026-4174    # load_custom_generate() fetching remote code: not used
